messages:
emma: Heads-up — CloudMart (marketplace) says they will require renaming header `X-RDWD-Client` -> `X-RW-Consumer` for listings. They asked for a compatibility plan and docs by EOD Fri.

leo: OK. short-term: accept both headers server-side and emit a deprecation telemetry event. long-term: require new header for new listings after N weeks.

nina: I'll draft SDK migration snippets and a one-page FAQ for marketplace reviewers. Example snippet: `client.setHeader('X-RW-Consumer', client.getHeader('X-RDWD-Client'))`.

sam_partner: CloudMart needs at least 8 weeks runway; some SI partners embed header in firmware. They want a test endpoint and a rollback plan.

leo: plan proposal:
- week 0: dual-accept + sampled deprecation logs (0.5%)
- week 3: partner comms + test endpoint + C reference snippet
- week 8: new listings require new header; older listings get grace for additional 4 weeks

ops-bot: deploy job started: `header-compat:v1` -> canary (4 nodes)

emma: @sam_partner please confirm CloudMart accepts 12-week total window. @nina wire the test endpoint into the marketplace doc.

ops-bot: deploy success: `header-compat:v1` -> canary (4 nodes) in 11m

sam_partner: CloudMart OK with 12 weeks if we provide test endpoint + rollback steps. I'll follow up with SI ETAs.

nina: Draft ready for review tomorrow AM. will include migration snippets for Node/Python/Go.

emma: Great. weekly check-in next Wed. Thanks :thumbsup:
